g.text: Zeno — the four-gate loop (Scope -> Route -> Execution -> Review)
Lite: one card line / Full: question rounds,
stop for answers, options, debate, recommendation
Done looks like on the card
against git log & the working tree
Write Scope onto the sized card
commit; log decision to the card
Flag the gap; recommend an Epic
Technical & API Specs / User & Admin Guides?
runs all four gates. Only true
by the time Gate 3 opens — TDD
Done at a time. No agent fleet,
